name: How do I choose the right height and profile for my baseboards?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right height and profile for my baseboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right height and profile depends on your home's style and ceiling height. Taller baseboards (5-8 inches) often suit homes with higher ceilings or more traditional/formal aesthetics. Shorter baseboards (3-4 inches) are common in modern or contemporary homes. The profile, whether simple or ornate, should complement the existing trim and architectural style of your space, enhancing its character without overwhelming it.
acceptedAnswer.description: Match height to ceiling height and room style; taller for high ceilings/traditional, shorter for modern. Choose a profile that complements existing trim.
